explanation: Merges main into the route-landing change. From main: App.tsx no longer renders the session-dismissible beta notice under the explorer header. From this branch: bootState and applyRoute are replaced by the pure route-landing module, so boot and Back/Forward land through the same landHash/settleExplorer path; a refused boot link no longer saves its chart scale, a trackless or unknown-track URL lands on the default track, a Compare link with a bad analysis in any query position is refused, an unknown dataset pasted mid-session restores the address bar, and App renders the error page ahead of the expression survey.
